name: orclab
description: Project-discipline skills and commands distilled from real practice: backlog tracking, release checklists, live-environment registries, currency and verification discipline, a deterministic /orc-code entry point for new-project, existing-project, and refactor work, /orc-version for versioning the current project, and /orc-git for common git/GitHub shortcuts. Every /orc-* command also ships as a matching skill for Claude Desktop compatibility. /orc-publish pushes a project's built artifacts to its own configured distribution channels.
